svg.title: Public debt in 2035: how far the primary balance, interest rates and growth move it
svg.desc: Effect on the debt-to-GDP ratio in 2035, in percentage points of GDP, relative to the Commission's baseline. Orange: debt rises; grey: debt falls; dotted outline: accounting calculation. Primary balance 1 percentage point of GDP higher every year, from 2028 to 2035: −8.2; market rates 0.2 percentage point lower (common funding assumption): −1.0; market rates 1 percentage point higher: +5.5; nominal growth 0.5 percentage point higher each year: −5.7; nominal growth 0.5 percentage point lower each year: +5.9.
svg.text: Public debt in 2035: how far the primary balance, interest rates and growth move it
Effect on the debt-to-GDP ratio in 2035, in percentage points of GDP, relative to the Commission's baseline
Orange: debt rises; grey: debt falls; dotted outline: accounting calculation.

Nominal growth 0.5 percentage point higher each year

Author's calculations based on the European Commission's baseline (Debt Sustainability Monitor 2025, France country
fiche), engine tested against the Commission and against the sensitivity published by the French Treasury (AFT).
Sensitivities: one parameter changed at a time, the others unchanged. These are not forecasts, full policy assessments
or a cost-benefit ranking.
